reasons.widowmaker-red: Azalea's dominate makes it impossible for an opponent to defend with two cards from hand, permanently guaranteeing the +3 power bonus while also shutting down defense reactions.
reasons.spire-sniping-red: It acts as an efficient red arrow that manipulates the top two cards of your deck when loaded face-up, perfectly setting up Azalea's ability.
reasons.sleep-dart-red: Pairing this arrow's game-winning ability disruption with Azalea's dominate makes the on-hit effect virtually guaranteed against defending heroes.
reasons.toxicity-red: It turns any dominated arrow attack into a lethal threat by forcing an additional five life loss when the attack hits.
reasons.over-flex-red: Provides a massive +4 power boost to your next arrow attack while reloading your arsenal to maintain consistent turn-to-turn momentum.
reasons.fletch-a-red-tail-red: Grants +4 power with go again and leverages Crow's Nest aim counters to degrade the defense value of opposing red cards.
reasons.increase-the-tension-red: Buffs your arrow by +3 power and completely locks defense reactions out of hand, ensuring dominated attacks connect cleanly.
reasons.head-shot-red: Naturally gains +2 power whenever it is flipped into arsenal via Azalea's hero power or Death Dealer, making it an extremely cost-effective attack.
reasons.hamstring-shot-red: Taxes the opponent's first attack on their subsequent turn when forced through with dominate, severely restricting their offensive counterplay.
reasons.sedation-shot-red: Synergizes with Crow's Nest to gain aim counter bonuses and inflicts an Inertia token on hit to ruin the opponent's arsenal setup.
